findings.reason: a worker implementing §19 exactly and driving the hook (as §13's done-when does) sees the assertion fail and must either amend the reload path §19 does not own and does not list as a write path, or silently substitute a direct `not_fresh_line` unit call; the plan should say which, since the two are different measures.
findings.text: the done-when's last clause ("With the seat's own stamp also other than the checkout's, the line says the producer is running older code, as today") is not produced by either hook path: a seat-stamp mismatch yields `STALE_CODE`, and both the prompt path (reckon/hooks/coordinator_obligations.py:941) and the stop path (coordinator_obligations.py:1182) gate `not_fresh_line` behind `reload_in_progress`, which returns True unconditionally for `STALE_CODE` (reckon/crew/obligation_snapshot.py:524), so the coordinator sees the reloading line ("producer reloading, last snapshot … old"), never "older code"
